verdict.rationale: NVIDIA docs describe 'Project G-Assist' as a built-in AI assistant powered by the GeForce RTX PC that lets users delegate system tuning, control, and optimization tasks, which matches the story. However this is a limited-scope assistant (system tuning only) with no independent/hands-on corroboration, and no detail on task delegation breadth or reliability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of G-Assist's task delegation, detail on scope beyond system tuning, and confirmation it is broadly available/stable rather than an early feature.
